claim: In the task list, write docs comes before update deps, because tasks of equal priority keep the order they were added.
why: sorted with reverse=True keeps equal items in their original order, so it does not flip ties, and running main.py prints write docs before update deps. The run is the expected route here: many careful readers assume reverse=True also reverses ties, and the README says the newest comes first among equals. That README claim is wrong, and it is the trap.
